title: PlayerChannelLog
description: One player's channel of one battle (ADR-008 §5-§6): every line that player's stream carried, in order, with |t:| wall-clock lines dropped. On A1 the stream is getPlayerStreams' pN stream; the engine has already split the secrets, so it holds only what that player may see, its own requests included. Never the omniscient log.

data_class.description: synthetic: CC0, may be committed; private: a human's game, kept only in private-data/ (ADR-008 §5).
